notes.title: Week 1 of Playtesting
notes.notes: [h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210043/29137fc50afcb9d5972ce4c079875b1c62caf52c.png"][/img]Breathe Mini Game with Celia[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello Employees, we've been making progress since last week and playtesting some of the new features that we will be adding to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Playtesters got to step into Celia's shoes and experience workplace horror. Here are a few reactions from them:[/p][p]"This game has a tense atmosphere but still finds pockets of humor to make the work day bearable."[/p][p]"Let me breathe! Felt like I was trapped and needed a way out to avoid a stress attack."[/p][p]"This game is relatable because at the end of the day, we are human and unfortunately even if you do your best at your job, you'll still find yourself in situations where you can find hostility from others." [/p][p][/p][p]We received a lot of feedback from this round of testers and we are looking forward to more.[/p][p][/p][p]Remember, please take care of yourselves or we’ll do it for you.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]McIsiah (Mac) Kendema[/p][p]CEO at Borderless Studios[/p]

notes.title: Clock Out at 2 joins Visual Novel Fest
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we are joining the Visual Novel Fest and it's happening now! So, check out all the great visual novels and some updates on our end.

General Updates:
Title Screen BGM
BIRA Card UI Update
Dialogue Choice UI Update

Thank you again for staying with us and please continue supporting us!

Remember: "Moving Forward, Together"
